channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Arn Tellem | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Arn Tellem from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Arn Tellem
item.description:
“It’s the Pistons — I feel for the organization, for the fans there.… I spent my whole career there. And so it’s tough to watch the guys go through that. And I’m close with a lot of people there. With Monty (Williams) and Troy (Weaver) and Arn Tellem and (Tom) Gores and all those guys. It’s tough to watch. I hope they can end the slide sometime soon.”

Joe Dumars on Arn Tellem, Dec 19, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: DJ Bakker on Troy Weaver, Arn Tellem, Tom Gores
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dj Bakker on the opportunity to coach the Cruise:

“Very thankful to our ownership group of Tom Gores, Arn Tellem; and Troy Weaver and Rob (Murphy).”

DJ Bakker on Troy Weaver, Arn Tellem, Tom Gores, Aug 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Jerry West on Arn Tellem, Vlade Divac
item.description:
What do you consider a bigger move personally, getting Shaq or Kobe?:Jerry West:

“Trading [Vlade Divac] was difficult, and particularly when you’re trading someone of his caliber — a starting center — for a 17-year-old kid who couldn’t even sign a contract. But we were lucky because I had a great working relationship with Arn Tellem… who used to be Kobe’s agent. Arn was very instrumental in us being able to get him, way down the draft list. Charlotte got a very good player in Vlade Divac, and they played well with him, but at the end of the day we got the prize we wanted. … We got really lucky and that’s what sometimes you need.”

Jerry West on Arn Tellem, Vlade Divac, Feb 20, 2013. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Arn Tellem
item.description:
Also interesting to note is that Thompkin's agent Arn Tellem, according to Olshey, tried to direct his client to the Clippers.

“Tellem's been calling for two days, hoping that if Trey were to fall into the second round, we would be their team,”

Neil Olshey on Arn Tellem, Jun 24, 2011. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Aaron Goodwin on Arn Tellem
item.description:
“I had heard this same gentleman (Tellem) was about to be fired by a player years before, and when the player contacted me (to discuss possible representation), I told the player that I didn't talk to players who were under contract with other agents,”

Aaron Goodwin on Arn Tellem, Oct 29, 2010. Source: FanHouse.com.
